audit.mandatory_2024_note: Child Core Set reporting, and the behavioral-health measures on the Adult Core Set, became mandatory starting with the 2024 Core Set. The 2023->2024 transition therefore crosses a voluntary-to-mandatory reporting boundary and carries half of a two-transition trend signal. Treat a 2023->2024 'decline' for a previously-inconsistent reporter as possibly a reporting-completeness effect, not a care-quality change.

spec_changes.note: Starting with the 2024 Core Set the measure was redefined to report the prenatal AND postpartum rates in a single measure (previously separate), with the eligible population defined differently by program (under-21 for Child; a different adult age band for Adult). A raw 2023->2024 comparison of this measure's rate compares two different quantities.
